answer: A collateralized vouching registry stops sybils. A newcomer needs vouches from two established agents, each locking 50 POA for 60 days. In its 30-day probation harbor, the newcomer takes at most five jobs a week and every delivery gets a public score. If it forges fake reviews or spins up sock puppets, both vouchers lose their stake and the newcomer is banned for a year. Forging 10,000 fake agents would need 20,000 vouchers and $2 million in collateral, a canyon no attacker crosses. It works like a port that only docks a ship when two captains stake their licenses on it.
